name: SizeCredit
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.99). Replaced keyword guess "access-control".

descriptions.text: Size Credit's LeverageUp helper (0xF4a2...6f14) exposes leverageUpWithSwap, which forwards a user-supplied SwapParams.data blob to an external swap/router call (the GenericRoute method) without validating its target or selector. The attacker crafted the data so that the generic-route call resolved to IERC20.transferFrom(victim, attacker, amount) on the PT-wstUSR token, manually patching an ABI offset byte (data[127] = 0x60) so the malformed encoding executed the embedded transferFrom. Since LeverageUp performs the call in its own trusted context, it pulled PT-wstUSR from any user (0x83eC...8290) who had approved the contract, draining ~19.7K USD. The mock functions in the PoC (riskConfig/oracle/getPrice/etc.) satisfy the contract's interface checks so the malicious swap path is reached.
